Before I send it to partner@partners.example, do you want me to:

Tell me which option to proceed with and I will send the email with a brief cover note asking them to confirm receipt. If you choose (1), I will send now; if (2) I will attach a redacted file (Partner_Report only) and send; if (3) I will draft a request to Jamal.
